description: This is the main FastAPI application source file for the Energy Insights Platform backend API. It defines route handlers for health checks, tenant/user management, data ingestion, analytics orchestration, and UI endpoints, along with middleware configuration and dependency injection. It integrates with multiple internal services and uses Pydantic models for schemas.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple status message.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] integration_notes()
methods.description: Provides environment configuration and end-to-end flow information for the platform.

methods.name: TenantOut create_tenant(payload: TenantCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new tenant record in the database, returning the tenant details.

methods.name: UserOut upsert_user(payload: UserCreate)
methods.description: Creates or updates a user associated with a tenant.

methods.name: MeterOut create_meter(payload: MeterCreate)
methods.description: Adds a new meter to the database.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] ingest_readings(payload: ReadingsIngest)
methods.description: Batch ingests meter readings into the database.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] upload_document( tenant_id: str, uploaded_by_user_id: Optional[str] = None, document_type: str = "unknown", file: UploadFile = File(...), )
methods.description: Uploads a document file and stores metadata in the database.

methods.name: AnalyticsOutputOut run_analytics(payload: AnalyticsRequest)
methods.description: Orchestrates analytics processing for a meter's data window, stores output, and conditionally triggers alerts.

methods.name: AlertOut trigger_alert(payload: AlertTrigger)
methods.description: Triggers an alert via the alerting service API.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] ui_list_meters( tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant UUID."), limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=500), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0), )
methods.description: Provides a list of meters with optional recent reading timestamps for UI display.

methods.name: List[DocumentOut] ui_list_documents( tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant UUID."), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0), )
methods.description: Provides a list of documents for a tenant for UI display.

methods.name: UsageSummaryOut ui_get_usage_summary( tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant UUID."), meter_id: str = Query(..., description="Meter UUID."), cost_per_kwh: float = Query(default=0.15, ge=0, description="Simple cost estimate."), )
methods.description: Computes and returns energy usage KPIs and anomaly scores for UI dashboard.

methods.name: BenchmarkingOut ui_get_benchmarking( tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant UUID."), meter_id: str = Query(..., description="Meter UUID."), window_days: int = Query(default=30, ge=7, le=365, description="Window size in days."), )
methods.description: Fetches benchmarking metrics from analytics service for UI display.

methods.name: List[UiAlertOut] ui_list_alerts( tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant UUID."), user_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional user UUID."), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0), )
methods.description: Lists alerts through alerting service for UI presentation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] ui_acknowledge_alert(alert_id: str)
methods.description: Acknowledge an alert via alerting service API.
